holdout.rule: last 3 years (longer than 25% of the 2016-01-04..2026-08-31 sample, doc 11 0b); untouched until the single final evaluation; one look only

hypothesis: Buying SPY at the 15:30 ET bar open and selling at the 16:00 close on sessions whose first half hour (previous close to 10:00) was up beats the vol-matched 60/40 (VTI/IEF) and T-bill cash net of cost_v2 at 2x cost. Cash earns BIL when not in the trade.
signal: research.strategy.sleeves.intraday_mom: r1 = close of the 09:30 bar / previous regular-session close - 1. pos: buy when r1 > 0. top_tercile: buy when r1 exceeds the 66.7th percentile of the last 250 sessions' r1 (at least 60 sessions of history, earlier sessions only). One trade per session in SPY: buy at the open of the 15:30 bar, sell at the close of the 16:00 bar, whole shares, full settled cash, 2 bps spread plus Section 31 and TAF fees (cost_v2). Sessions without 13 regular-session bars, and the session after them, are skipped. Prices are split+dividend adjusted SIP 30-minute bars.
